summary: We have developed an app that will make life easier for astronauts by helping them monitor their health and identify potential future health risks.
details: The main goal of our project is to make life easier for astronauts in one of the most important areas: health. To do this, our app collects information from sensors worn by astronauts or located on the ISS, processes it, and determines whether it is safe for the astronauts at that moment (data is updated every 2 minutes). The app also provides access to artificial intelligence that can assist the crew in emergency situations or with tasks outside their area of expertise; furthermore, it can analyze the sensor data and offer its own recommendations. The app was developed using programming languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript and Python. MongoDB database was used for the local storage and processing of information about astronauts. Gemini AI was selected as the artificial intelligence system to assist the astronauts. During development, we used a bottom-up development approach, starting with the fundamentals such as the database and server-side components and progressing to design and user interaction.
